All Additional Central P F Commissioners (Head Quarter)/All

Sub:-Empanelment of Advocates for respective Central
Government Industrial Tribunals- reg.

Sir,

As you are aware that vide Govt of India Gazette notification dated
26-05-2017, Employees Provident Fund Appellate Tribunals have been
merged with Central Government Industrial Tribunals. There are 22 no. of
CGITs in the Country.

It has been directed by the Central Provident Fund Commissioner
that wherever the Tribunal is located in places where High Court is also
available, an Advocate from the High Court panel may be selected to
defend Tribunal Cases also. In case there is no High Court in the locality
of Tribunal, fresh panel for the concerned Tribunal may be constituted by
the concerned Zonal ACCs.

(This issues with the approval of CPFC)
Yours’ faithfully,
